short.q: Calculate the percentage increase in beach gradient from 4° to 6°.
Describe how you would use one piece of equipment in your enquiry.
short.model: We used a tape measure placed across the river from bank to bank, and recorded the width to the nearest centimetre at each site.

short.q: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of annotated field sketches.
short.model: Advantage: they focus on key features and need no equipment. Disadvantage: they are subjective and do not provide numerical data.

short.q: Explain one way to make sure fieldwork results are accurate.
short.model: Repeat each measurement three times and take a mean, so that errors and anomalies have less effect.

short.q: Evaluate how effective your sampling was in helping you answer your enquiry title.
short.model: Systematic sampling every 20 m gave even coverage along the beach, but with only 6 sites some changes could be missed, so more sites would improve reliability.
